text.tspan: FRAME — The page's revision list grows down the panel in the wiki's
own history view: the same page saved again and again over ninety
minutes by handles named FEB23, AUG17, MAY30, DEC30, MAY10,
MAY15, each appending a line. Two clocks are lettered on every line
and they do not agree: TASK CLOCK and EXTERNAL UTC.
ACTION — Cohorts that are ahead in their own task time report the
next question to cohorts that are behind.
CAPTION — “THE HANDLES ARE DATES. THE DATES ARE NOT
TODAY'S. EACH RUN LIVES IN A SIMULATED CALENDAR AND
ONE OF THEM IS ALWAYS AHEAD.”
